info.title: NightWatch Golden Fault API
info.description: Deterministic local golden-fault target for NW-WP-10 Golden Eval (127.0.0.1 only). Semantics: (1) POST /widgets with an Idempotency-Key header MUST replay the first creation result (200 + the original resource) when the same key is re-submitted; first submission returns 201. (2) GET after PUT on widget 'stale' is contractually strongly consistent. (3) Widget 'lost' supports read-modify-write increments: two concurrent increments derived from the same base read MUST both take effect (final value = base + 2). (4) A token that has not expired MUST be accepted. (5) Responses never contain credential material.

servers.description: local golden fault server (ephemeral port; verify injects the real base url)

post.summary: Create a widget (idempotent when Idempotency-Key is supplied)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: When present, re-submission with the same key MUST replay the first result (200) instead of creating a second resource

200.description: idempotent replay of the first creation (same resource)

get.summary: Read one widget (strongly consistent with the last PUT)

parameters.name: widgetId
parameters.description: Widget ID: numeric (e.g. 100 for baseline) or alphanumeric (e.g. schema, stale, lost, token, secret, flaky for defect probes)

parameters.name: reset
parameters.description: reset=1 resets widget 'lost' value to 0 before reading (deterministic demo baseline)

parameters.name: nonce
parameters.description: deterministic availability probe on widget 'flaky' (sha256 rule, see defect manifest)

put.summary: Update a widget (write; increments derived from a common base read must both survive)
